items.title: Settle the fragmentation deficit and the information save shape
acceptance: a Decision logged block in docs/roadmap.md or a daily log names how a crossing's pre-crossing connectivity deficit is measured and how it maps onto the 1.0 to 2.0 fragmentation multiplier

the same block says whether the new optional crossings[].fragmentation_deficit field bumps save_version, with the reason (data-schemas §14 says a bump is MAJOR; ADR 0014 says absent optional keys take defaults)
the same block names how a purchased information product is recorded under the information save key, since areas_revealed[] cannot say which of three products an area holds
items.context: Two spec gaps found while routing Phase 3. The PRD says the multiplier comes 'from the pre-crossing connectivity deficit of the link' and defines no deficit; the code has no such measure. A proposal to accept or change: deficit = 1 minus (the larger pre-crossing network's tile count divided by the combined network's tile count after the link), so a link that joins two equal halves scores 0.5 and one that joins a sliver to a large network scores near 0; multiplier = FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MIN + deficit x (FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MAX - FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MIN). On the save: an optional float with a default of 0.0 loads under save_version 1 by ADR 0014's omit-means-default rule, so no bump. On information: keep areas_revealed[] and add a products map keyed by area id, or encode product and area together. Unblocks C14, C15 and C17. The dispatch cannot see a decision as done, so those items stay blocked until the next weekly plan marks Q4 done.

items.title: Add the economy manager with starting budget, spend and credit
acceptance: economy_manager.gd exists as class EconomyManager with a one-line docstring and is owned and wired by Simulation like the other systems
a new game starts at EconomyConstants.STARTING_BUDGET (50,000), including GameState.reset(); economy_manager_test.gd asserts it as test_starting_budget

spend() returns false and leaves the balance unchanged when the amount exceeds the balance; credit() and spend() each emit budget_changed once through Simulation to EventBus (test_budget_changed_emitted)
budget and last_donation survive the save round trip: a test saves from GameState.to_dict() after a spend and restores the same values with from_dict()
the stated suite figure in docs/testing-setup.md is updated with tools/suite_figures.py --print and python3 tools/suite_figures.py --check docs/testing-setup.md passes
items.context: Phase 3's first system. The constants (economy_constants.gd) and signals (event_bus.gd: budget_changed, donation_received) exist; nothing sets or spends the budget, and game_state.gd defaults budget to 0. Everything else in Phase 3 spends or credits through this.

items.title: Charge for crossings and make the budget gate functional
acceptance: Simulation.build_crossing deducts cost_per_tile from infrastructure.json times the covered tiles on success: a three-tile overpass takes 50,000 to 35,000 (test_overpass_cost_per_tile)
build_crossing with a budget below the cost returns false, covers no tile and leaves the budget unchanged
an invalid span, a cancelled build and a rejected confirm cost nothing
main.gd passes ConfirmPanel the cost of one tile of the cheapest crossing type with available_in_v1 true, read from the registry rather than 0; the 'display-only' comment is updated
the build status label shows the remaining budget and the log message on a refused build names the shortfall
no literal 5000 or 15000 appears in the changed scripts
the stated suite figure in docs/testing-setup.md is updated with tools/suite_figures.py --print and python3 tools/suite_figures.py --check docs/testing-setup.md passes
items.context: Today the budget gate is display-only: main.gd passes a minimum crossing cost of 0 and build_mode.running_cost() is informational. This makes the 2026-09-23 note that the confirm path is 'met in tests' true for cost as well.

items.title: Store the fragmentation deficit on each crossing and in the save
acceptance: a completed crossing records the deficit computed before its safe link is added, by the rule Q4 logged, as an optional field on crossings[]

the field is written by save_state and read back by restore_state as stored; a restored crossing keeps its saved value rather than recomputing it, because restore replays crossings against a partly built graph
a save with no such key loads with the Q4 default and does not fail
docs/data-schemas.md §14 documents the field; if Q4 chose a save_version bump, the migration step and its test are included and the pull request says so in its first line
the stated suite figure in docs/testing-setup.md is updated with tools/suite_figures.py --print and python3 tools/suite_figures.py --check docs/testing-setup.md passes
items.context: Supervised because it changes the save format. The roadmap's 2026-10-15 block decided to store the deficit on the crossing; Q4 supplies the formula and the version answer. Do not start before Q4 is logged.

items.title: Pay monthly donations and the fundraising trickle
acceptance: at each month boundary Simulation calls the economy's monthly income, which pays BASE_GRANT plus, per crossing, this month's crossings times the mean species status_weight times the stored fragmentation multiplier, plus a milestone term (test_donation_formula)
the milestone term is a named function that returns 0, with a comment pointing at Phase 6
endangered crossings pay more than common ones for equal usage (test_status_weight_scaling) and the multiplier stays within FRAGMENTATION_MULT_MIN and MAX (test_fragmentation_multiplier_range)
when the budget is below the cost of the cheapest action, FUNDRAISING_TRICKLE is added (test_fundraising_trickle_prevents_deadlock)
donation_received(amount, breakdown) is emitted through EventBus with the base, per-crossing and milestone parts; the per-crossing tally resets each month
the stated suite figure in docs/testing-setup.md is updated with tools/suite_figures.py --print and python3 tools/suite_figures.py --check docs/testing-setup.md passes
items.context: Phase 3 exit criteria: the donation formula matches the spec across status weights and fragmentation multipliers, and the trickle prevents deadlock. Tallies come from animal_crossed; species weights from species_stats.json status_weight.

items.title: Document a safeguard against game/project.godot losing its comments
acceptance: game/CLAUDE.md states that opening the project in the Godot editor can silently strip project.godot's comments on save, and instructs running git diff -- game/project.godot before staging any commit that touched the editor
the note names the 2026-09-25 incident (comments lost, caught, reverted before commit) as the reason
items.context: Caught live 2026-09-25 while landing C1: project.godot lost every comment mid-session, most likely from the editor resaving it, and was reverted before it landed in any commit. No regeneration fix is known; a documented pre-commit check is the cheap mitigation until one is. PR #47 has since committed project.godot comment-free and docs/project-godot-settings.md records why; Q2 decides whether this item is still wanted.
